img")?.getAttribute("src")); const cards = cardElements.map((card, index) => { const topWrap = card.querySelector(".top-wrap"); const jacketUrl = absoluteUrl(extractCssUrl(topWrap?.getAttribute("style") || "")); const step = parseStep(card); const titleAndArtist = cleanText(card.querySelector(".mid-wrap")); const separatorIndex = titleAndArtist.lastIndexOf(" - "); const songTitle = separatorIndex >= 0 ? titleAndArtist.slice(0, separatorIndex) : titleAndArtist; const artist = separatorIndex >= 0 ? titleAndArtist.slice(separatorIndex + 3) : ""; const gradeUrl = card.querySelector(".bottom-wrap .grade img")?.getAttribute("src") || ""; const plateUrl = card.querySelector(".bottom-wrap .plate img")?.getAttribute("src") || ""; return { rank: index + 1, jacketUrl, mode: step.mode, level: step.level, levelBallUrl: step.levelBallUrl, modeIconUrl: step.modeIconUrl, levelDigitUrls: step.levelDigitUrls, songTitle, artist, grade: parseGrade(gradeUrl), gradeUrl: absoluteUrl(gradeUrl), plate: parsePlate(plateUrl), plateUrl: absoluteUrl(plateUrl), point: compactNumberText(card.querySelector(".bottom-wrap .score")), rawScore: "", }; }); return { nickname, profileTitle, tier, totalScore, tierIconUrl, logoUrl: absoluteUrl("/l_img/logo.png"), cards, generatedAt: new Date(), }; } function cleanText(element) { return (element?.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(); } function compactNumberText(element) { return (element?.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, "").trim(); } function absoluteUrl(value) { if (!value) { return ""; } try { return new URL(value, location.origin).href; } catch { return ""; } } function extractCssUrl(value) { const match = value.match(/url\(\s*(["']?)(.*?)\1\s*\)/i); return match ? match[2] : ""; } function fileStem(value) { try { const pathname = new URL(value, location.origin).pathname; const fileName = pathname.slice(pathname.lastIndexOf("/") + 1); return fileName.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""); } catch { return ""; } } function parseGrade(value) { const stem = fileStem(value).toLowerCase(); if (!stem) { return "-"; } return stem.endsWith("_p") ? `${stem.slice(0, -2).toUpperCase()}+` : stem.toUpperCase(); } function parsePlate(value) { const stem = fileStem(value).toLowerCase(); return stem ? stem.split("_").pop().toUpperCase() : "-"; } function parseStep(element) { const stepBall = element.querySelector(".stepBall_in"); const stepImages = [...(stepBall?.querySelectorAll("img") || [])].map((image) => image.getAttribute("src") || ""); const modeSource = stepImages.find((src) => /\/(s|d|c)_text\.png(?:\?|$)/i.test(src)) || ""; const modeMatch = modeSource.match(/\/(s|d|c)_text\.png(?:\?|$)/i); const levelDigitUrls = stepImages.filter((src) => /_num_\d\.png(?:\?|$)/i.test(src)).map(absoluteUrl); return { mode: modeMatch ? modeMatch[1].toUpperCase() : "?", level: levelDigitUrls .map((src) => src.match(/_num_(\d)\.png(?:\?|$)/i)?.[1] || "") .filter(Boolean) .join(""), levelBallUrl: absoluteUrl(extractCssUrl(stepBall?.getAttribute("style") || "")), modeIconUrl: absoluteUrl(modeSource), levelDigitUrls, }; } async function attachRawScores(data, signal, onProgress) { const (firstResult.total > 0 && pageSize === 0) { throw new Error(`Lv.${levelFilter} 순점수 목록을 읽지 못했습니다.`); } const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(firstResult.total / Math.max(1, pageSize))); function bestScoreLevelFilter(level) { const value = Number(level); if (!Number.isFinite(value)) { return ""; } if (value < 10) { return "all"; } return value >= 27 ? "27over" : String(value); } async function fetchBestScorePage(level, page, signal) { const url = new URL(BEST_SCORE_PATH, location.origin); if (level !== "all") { url.searchParams.set("lv", level); } url.searchParams.set("page", String(page)); const response = await fetch(url.href, { method: "GET", credentials: "same-origin", cache: "no-store", redirect: "follow", signal, headers: { Accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml", }, }); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`순점수 페이지를 불러오지 못했습니다. (${response.status})`); } return new DOMParser().parseFromString(await response.text(), "text/html"); } function parseBestScorePage(source) { const totalText = cleanText(source.querySelector(".total_wrap .t2")); const total = Number(totalText.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")) || 0; const entries = [...source.querySelectorAll(".recently_playeList > li")].map((card) => { const step = parseStep(card); const jacketStyle = card.querySelector(".wrap_in > .in.bgfix")?.getAttribute("style") || ""; return { jacketUrl: absoluteUrl(extractCssUrl(jacketStyle)), songTitle: cleanText(card.querySelector(".song_name p")), mode: step.mode, level: step.level, rawScore: cleanText(card.querySelector(".con2 .li_in.ac .tx")), }; }).filter((entry) => entry.rawScore); return { total, entries }; } function addBestScoreEntries(entries, scoreByChart, scoreByTitle) { entries.forEach((entry) => { scoreByChart.set(chartKey(entry.jacketUrl, entry.mode, entry.level), entry.rawScore); scoreByTitle.set(titleKey(entry.songTitle, entry.mode, entry.level), entry.rawScore); }); } function chartKey(jacketUrl, mode, level) { return `${fileStem(jacketUrl)}|${mode}|${level}`; } function titleKey(songTitle, mode, level) { return `${songTitle.toLocaleLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "")}|${mode}|${level}`; } async function loadImages(urls, signal, onProgress) { const uniqueUrls = [...new Set(urls.filter(Boolean))]; const result = new Map(); let cursor = 0; let loaded = 0; const worker = async () => { while (cursor < uniqueUrls.length) { const index = cursor; cursor += 1; const url = uniqueUrls[index]; try { const parsedUrl = new URL(url, location.href); if (parsedUrl.origin !== location.origin) { throw new Error("동일 출처가 아닌 이미지는 사용하지 않습니다."); } const response = await fetch(parsedUrl.href, { credentials: "same-origin", cache: "force-cache", signal, }); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`이미지 응답 오류 ${response.status}`); } const blob = await response.blob(); result.set(url, await blobToImage(blob)); } catch (error) { if (error && error.name === "AbortError") { throw error; } result.set(url, null); } finally { loaded += 1; onProgress(loaded, uniqueUrls.length); } } }; const workerCount = Math.min(8, Math.max(1, uniqueUrls.length)); await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: workerCount }, () => worker())); return result; } async function blobToImage(blob) { if ("createImageBitmap" in window) { return createImageBitmap(blob); } const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob); try { const image = new Image(); image.src = objectUrl; await image.decode(); return image; } finally { URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl); } } function renderPumbility(data, images) { const width = 2000; const height = 1600; const canvas = document.createElement("canvas"); const cardHeight = 188; const gap = 12; const startX = 56; const startY = 250; data.cards.slice(0, 50).forEach((card, index) => { const column = index % columns; const row = Math.floor(index / columns); return canvas; } function drawBackground(ctx, width, height) { const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, width, height); gradient.addColorStop(0, "#10182a"); gradient.addColorStop(0.48, "#0b1120"); gradient.addColorStop(1, "#141126"); ctx.fillStyle = gradient; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height); const glowA = ctx.createRadialGradient(1650, 40, 0, 1650, 40, 720); glowA.addColorStop(0, "rgba(99,95,255,.30)"); glowA.addColorStop(1, "rgba(99,95,255,0)"); ctx.fillStyle = glowA; ctx.fillRect(900, 0, 1100, 900); const glowB = ctx.createRadialGradient(140, 1240, 0, 140, 1240, 620); glowB.addColorStop(0, "rgba(32,177,190,.16)"); glowB.addColorStop(1, "rgba(32,177,190,0)"); ctx.fillStyle = glowB; ctx.fillRect(0, 700, 900, 900); ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(132,153,201,.055)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = 0; x <= width; x += 64) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, height); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = 0; y <= height; y += 64) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(width, y); ctx.stroke(); } } function drawHeader(ctx, data, images, width) { roundedPath(ctx, 40, 34, width - 80, 148, 24); const panel = ctx.createLinearGradient(40, 34, width - 40, 182); panel.addColorStop(0, "rgba(24,37,64,.96)"); panel.addColorStop(1, "rgba(28,24,55,.94)"); ctx.fillStyle = panel; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(124,155,230,.20)"; ctx.stroke(); const logo = images.get(data.logoUrl); if (logo) { drawContain(ctx, logo, 62, 58, 218, 92); } else { ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.font = `900 25px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText("PUMP IT UP", 68, 112); } ctx.fillStyle = "#8ea0c7"; ctx.font = `700 14px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText(data.profileTitle || "PLAYER", 318, 76); ctx.fillStyle = "#f7f9ff"; ctx.font = `900 35px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; drawFittedText(ctx, data.nickname || "PLAYER", 318, 119, 650); const generatedDateTime = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ko-KR", { year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit", }).format(data.generatedAt); ctx.fillStyle = "#7f8baa"; ctx.font = `600 14px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText(`생성 일시 · ${generatedDateTime}`, 320, 148); const icon = images.get(data.tierIconUrl); if (icon) { drawContain(ctx, icon, 1398, 50, 112, 112); } ctx.fillStyle = "#98a6c4"; ctx.font = `700 15px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText(data.tier || "PUMBILITY", 1534, 75); const scoreTheme = getPumbilityColorTheme(data.totalScore); const scoreGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(1534, 86, 1930, 146); scoreTheme.colors.forEach((color, index) => { scoreGradient.addColorStop(index / (scoreTheme.colors.length - 1), color); }); ctx.fillStyle = scoreGradient; ctx.font = `900 55px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; if (scoreTheme.stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = scoreTheme.stroke; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.strokeText(data.totalScore || "0", 1530, 134); } ctx.fillText(data.totalScore || "0", 1530, 134); } function getPumbilityColorTheme(totalScore) { const value = Number(String(totalScore || "0").replace(/[^\d.]/g, "")); return PUMBILITY_COLOR_TIERS.find((tier) => value >= tier.minimum) || PUMBILITY_COLOR_TIERS.at(-1); } function drawCard(ctx, card, images, x, y, width, height) { const jacket = images.get(card.jacketUrl); placeholder.addColorStop(1, "#3a2550"); ctx.fillStyle = placeholder; ctx.fillRect(x, y, width, 112); ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.22)"; ctx.font = `800 26px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.fillText("SCORE", x + 8, y + 104); ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.font = `900 12px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.fillText(card.rawScore || "-", x + width - 8, y + 104); ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.fillStyle = "#f4f6ff"; ctx.font = `800 13px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; drawFittedText(ctx, card.songTitle || "-", x + 10, y + 133, width - 20); ctx.fillStyle = "#8f9ab5"; ctx.font = `600 10px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; drawFittedText(ctx, card.artist || "", x + 10, y + 150, width - 20); ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.08)"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + 9, y + 158); ctx.lineTo(x + width - 9, y + 158); ctx.stroke(); const gradeImage = images.get(card.gradeUrl); if (gradeImage) { drawContain(ctx, gradeImage, x + 9, y + 163, 34, 22); } else { drawBadge(ctx, card.grade, x + 9, y + 165, "#25304a", "#d9e2f7", 34, 10); } const plateImage = images.get(card.plateUrl); if (plateImage) { drawContain(ctx, plateImage, x + 49, y + 163, 42, 22); } else { drawBadge(ctx, card.plate, x + 49, y + 165, "#b5bfd2", "#0c1020", 34, 10); } ctx.fillStyle = "#86d9ff"; ctx.font = `900 14px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.fillText(card.point || "-", x + width - 9, y + 180); ctx.textAlign = "left"; } function drawStepBall(ctx, card, images, x, y, width, height) { const background = images.get(card.levelBallUrl); const modeIcon = images.get(card.modeIconUrl); const digitImages = card.levelDigitUrls.map((url) => images.get(url)).filter(Boolean); if (!background || !modeIcon || digitImages.length !== card.levelDigitUrls.length) { const modeColor = card.mode === "S" ? "#e95670" : card.mode === "D" ? "#2bb8a6" : "#8a7bea"; drawBadge(ctx, `${card.mode}${card.level}`, x + 8, y + 2, modeColor, "#ffffff", width - 8, 11); return; } ctx.drawImage(background, x, y, width, height); ctx.drawImage(modeIcon, x + 1, y + 5, width - 2, 9); const digitWidth = 15; const digitHeight = 18; const digitsWidth = digitImages.length * digitWidth; const digitX = x + (width - digitsWidth) / 2; digitImages.forEach((image, index) => { ctx.drawImage(image, digitX + index * digitWidth, y + 14, digitWidth, digitHeight); }); } function drawUpgradeGuide(ctx, data, images, x, y, width, height) { const cutoff = Math.min(...data.cards.map((card) => Number(card.point.replace(/,/g, ""))).filter(Number.isFinite)); const rows = buildCombinedGuideRows(cutoff); const plateBonuses = buildPlateBonuses(rows[0]?.skillLevel || 10); drawPanel(ctx, x, y, width, height); ctx.fillStyle = "#eef3ff"; ctx.font = `800 18px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText("TOP 50 갱신 가이드", x + 22, y + 31); ctx.fillStyle = "#86d9ff"; ctx.font = `800 14px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.fillText(`현재 최저 ${cutoff.toFixed(2)} 초과 기준`, x + width - 22, y + 31); ctx.textAlign = "left"; const tableX = x + 22; const tableWidth = 560; const bonusX = tableX + tableWidth + 24; const bonusWidth = width - tableWidth - 68; const headerY = y + 58; ctx.fillStyle = "#71809e"; ctx.font = `700 10px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText("추천 레벨", tableX + 8, headerY); ctx.fillText("RG 최소 점수", tableX + 105, headerY); ctx.fillText("랭크", tableX + 315, headerY); ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.fillText("예상", tableX + tableWidth - 10, headerY); ctx.textAlign = "left"; rows.forEach((row, index) => { const rowY = y + 67 + index * 28; roundedPath(ctx, tableX, rowY, tableWidth, 24, 7); ctx.fillStyle = index % 2 === 0 ? "rgba(130,151,202,.10)" : "rgba(130,151,202,.045)"; ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#f3f6ff"; ctx.font = `800 11px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText(row.levelLabel, tableX + 8, rowY + 17); const scoreText = formatGuideModeValues(row.single, row.double, (requirement) => ( requirement.score.toLocaleString("ko-KR") )); ctx.fillText(scoreText, tableX + 105, rowY + 17); ctx.fillStyle = "#b9c6df"; ctx.fillText(row.grade, tableX + 315, rowY + 17); ctx.fillStyle = "#86d9ff"; const pumbilityText = formatGuideModeValues(row.single, row.double, (requirement) => ( requirement.pumbility.toFixed(2) )); ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.fillText(pumbilityText, tableX + tableWidth - 10, rowY + 17); ctx.textAlign = "left"; }); ctx.fillStyle = "#dce5f8"; ctx.font = `800 12px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText(`플레이트 보너스 · ${rows[0]?.levelLabel || "-"} 기준`, bonusX, headerY); const bonusColumnWidth = (bonusWidth - 30) / 4; plateBonuses.forEach((bonus, index) => { const column = index % 4; const row = Math.floor(index / 4); const chipX = bonusX + column * (bonusColumnWidth + 10); const chipY = y + 69 + row * 40; roundedPath(ctx, chipX, chipY, bonusColumnWidth, 32, 8); ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(130,151,202,.08)"; ctx.fill(); const plateImage = images.get(absoluteUrl(bonus.plate.path)); if (plateImage) { drawContain(ctx, plateImage, chipX + 7, chipY + 4, 56, 24); } else { ctx.fillStyle = "#dce5f8"; ctx.font = `900 12px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText(bonus.plate.code, chipX + 12, chipY + 21); } ctx.fillStyle = "#86d9ff"; ctx.textAlign = "right"; if (bonus.plate.code === "UG" || bonus.plate.code === "EG") { ctx.font = `900 11px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText(`S +${bonus.single.toFixed(2)}`, chipX + bonusColumnWidth - 9, chipY + 13); ctx.fillText(`D +${bonus.double.toFixed(2)}`, chipX + bonusColumnWidth - 9, chipY + 25); } else { ctx.font = `900 14px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText(`+${bonus.single.toFixed(2)}`, chipX + bonusColumnWidth - 9, chipY + 21); } ctx.textAlign = "left"; }); ctx.fillStyle = "#7885a2"; ctx.font = `600 11px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.fillText("RG 기준 최소 점수", x + 22, y + height - 12); } function drawRightsNotice(ctx, width, height) { ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(152,166,196,.48)"; ctx.font = `600 10px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.fillText(RIGHTS_NOTICE, width - 56, height - 22); ctx.textAlign = "left"; } function buildCombinedGuideRows(cutoff) { const roughPlate = GUIDE_PLATES.find((plate) => plate.code === "RG"); let startingLevel = 10; while (startingLevel <= 28) { const maximumValue = startingLevel <= 26 ? Math.min( calculatePumbility("S", startingLevel, "SSS+", roughPlate), calculatePumbility("D", startingLevel + 1, "SSS+", roughPlate), ) : calculatePumbility("D", startingLevel + 1, "SSS+", roughPlate); if (maximumValue > cutoff) { break; } startingLevel += 1; } const rows = []; for (let skillLevel = startingLevel; skillLevel <= 28 && rows.length < 5; skillLevel += 1) { if (skillLevel >= 27) { const doubleLevel = skillLevel + 1; const double = buildGuideRequirement("D", doubleLevel, cutoff, roughPlate); if (!double) { continue; } rows.push({ skillLevel, levelLabel: `D${doubleLevel}`, single: null, double, grade: double.grade, pumbility: double.pumbility, }); continue; } const single = buildGuideRequirement("S", skillLevel, cutoff, roughPlate); const double = buildGuideRequirement("D", skillLevel + 1, cutoff, roughPlate); if (!single && !double) { continue; } const stricter = !single ? double : !double ? single : single.score >= double.score ? single : double; const strictValues = [ single ? calculatePumbility("S", skillLevel, stricter.grade, roughPlate) : NaN, double ? calculatePumbility("D", skillLevel + 1, stricter.grade, roughPlate) : NaN, ].filter(Number.isFinite); rows.push({ skillLevel, levelLabel: `S${skillLevel} · D${skillLevel + 1}`, single, double, grade: stricter.grade, pumbility: Math.min(...strictValues), }); } return rows; } function buildGuideRequirement(mode, level, cutoff, plate) { const requirement = SCORE_GRADE_GUIDE.find(([grade]) => ( calculatePumbility(mode, level, grade, plate) > cutoff )); if (!requirement) { return null; } return { levelLabel: `${mode}${level}`, grade: requirement[0], score: requirement[1], pumbility: calculatePumbility(mode, level, requirement[0], plate), }; } function formatGuideModeValues(single, double, formatter) { if (single && double) { const singleValue = formatter(single); const doubleValue = formatter(double); return singleValue === doubleValue ? singleValue : `S ${singleValue} · D ${doubleValue}`; } if (single) { return `S ${formatter(single)}`; } if (double) { return `D ${formatter(double)}`; } return "-"; } function buildPlateBonuses(skillLevel) { const base = skillLevel <= 23 ? 7.5 * (skillLevel + 27) : 375 + 15 * (skillLevel - 23); return GUIDE_PLATES.map((plate) => { const singleBonus = truncatePumbility(base * plate.bonus.S / 750); const doubleBonus = truncatePumbility(base * plate.bonus.D / 750); return { plate, single: singleBonus, double: doubleBonus, }; }); } function calculatePumbility(mode, level, grade, plate) { const skillLevel = level - (mode === "D" ? 1 : 0); const base = skillLevel <= 23 ? 7.5 * (skillLevel + 27) : 375 + 15 * (skillLevel - 23); const rankPenalty = RANK_PENALTIES[mode][grade]; const value = base * (750 - 5 * rankPenalty + plate.bonus[mode]) / 750; return truncatePumbility(value); } function truncatePumbility(value) { return Math.floor((value + 1e-9) * 100) / 100; } function drawPanel(ctx, x, y, width, height) { roundedPath(ctx, x, y, width, height, 18); ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(17,25,44,.82)"; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(125,148,202,.16)"; ctx.stroke(); } function drawBadge(ctx, text, x, y, background, foreground, width, fontSize = 11) { roundedPath(ctx, x, y, width, 22, 7); ctx.fillStyle = background; ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = foreground; ctx.font = `900 ${fontSize}px ${FONT_FAMILY}`; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.fillText(text || "-", x + width / 2, y + 15); ctx.textAlign = "left"; } function drawCover(ctx, image, x, y, width, height) { const sourceWidth = image.width || image.naturalWidth; const sourceHeight = image.height || image.naturalHeight; const scale = Math.max(width / sourceWidth, height / sourceHeight); const cropWidth = width / scale; const cropHeight = height / scale; const sourceX = (sourceWidth - cropWidth) / 2; const sourceY = (sourceHeight - cropHeight) / 2; ctx.drawImage(image, sourceX, sourceY, cropWidth, cropHeight, x, y, width, height); } function drawContain(ctx, image, x, y, width, height) { const sourceWidth = image.width || image.naturalWidth; const sourceHeight = image.height || image.naturalHeight; const scale = Math.min(width / sourceWidth, height / sourceHeight); const drawWidth = sourceWidth * scale; const drawHeight = sourceHeight * scale; ctx.drawImage(image, x + (width - drawWidth) / 2, y + (height - drawHeight) / 2, drawWidth, drawHeight); } function drawFittedText(ctx, text, x, y, maxWidth) { if (ctx.measureText(text).width <= maxWidth) { ctx.fillText(text, x, y); return; } const ellipsis = "…"; let low = 0; let high = text.length; while (low < high) { const middle = Math.ceil((low + high) / 2); const candidate = `${text.slice(0, middle)}${ellipsis}`; if (ctx.measureText(candidate).width <= maxWidth) { low = middle; } else { high = middle - 1; } } ctx.fillText(`${text.slice(0, low)}${ellipsis}`, x, y); } function roundedPath(ctx, x, y, width, height, radius) { const safeRadius = Math.min(radius, width / 2, height / 2); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + safeRadius, y); ctx.arcTo(x + width, y, x + width, y + height, safeRadius); ctx.arcTo(x + width, y + height, x, y + height, safeRadius); ctx.arcTo(x, y + height, x, y, safeRadius); ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + width, y, safeRadius); ctx.closePath(); } function canvasToBlob(canvas) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { canvas.toBlob((blob) => { if (blob) { resolve(blob); } else { reject(new Error("PNG 파일을 만들지 못했습니다.")); } }, "image/png"); }); } function sanitizeFileName(value) { return value.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|#]+/g, "_").replace(/\s+/g, "_").slice(0, 80); } })();
